tasks.short: Keep pension, insurance and any savings arrangements correct when employees join, leave or change their hours.

today.trigger: An employee change, provider request, contribution invoice or benefits renewal.
steps: Check the employee change in AFAS against the applicable scheme and CAO.
Prepare enrolment, amendment or termination information for the provider.
Resolve missing information with the employee, Payroll or broker.
Compare provider confirmations and contributions with AFAS and invoices.
Record the outcome and explain any employee action.
systems: Provider files or portals, where available
drudgery: Entering the same employee change in several places
Matching provider contributions to payroll deductions
today.time_sinks: 193.1 hours/year supplied. Likely bottlenecks are reconciliation and provider follow-up; the actual split needs measurement.

lenses.faster: Generate provider-specific change files from AFAS and compare confirmations automatically. Manual copying and checking unchanged records disappear.
lenses.autonomous: An approved AFAS change starts eligibility checks, prepares a submission and tracks acknowledgement. Missing fields, conflicting rules and rejected records enter an exception queue.
lenses.ambitious: Check every eligible employee for missing cover and contribution mismatches each month. Give new starters a clear benefits checklist in week one.
lenses.joy: Remove spreadsheet matching and reminder chasing. Keep the conversations that help employees understand their choices.
lenses.options: Compare renewal options on coverage, exclusions, employee contributions and employer cost. Show separate effects for shift workers and office staff.
lenses.altitude: Own the eligibility rules, provider service standards and reconciliation controls. Review exceptions rather than rebuild each submission.
reach: HR Administrator: benefits onboarding checks
Payroll Specialist: contribution discrepancy preparation
Accounts Payable: provider invoice reconciliation support

tasks.human_edge: Explain sensitive choices, challenge a provider and resolve disputed eligibility. The specialist checks scheme interpretation; employees make their own elections.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: deterministic rules prepare changes and reconciliations; an optional llm_step extracts proposed fields from provider letters. A person approves submissions and exceptions before they affect coverage or deductions.

in_practice.trigger: A scheduled AFAS change extract or arrival of a provider confirmation or invoice.
steps: Read approved employee changes and apply versioned eligibility and contribution rules.
Validate required fields and produce the provider's supported file format.
Present the batch, exceptions and employee impact for approval.
Submit through an agreed channel after approval and track acknowledgement.
Reconcile confirmed cover and contributions; route corrections to Payroll or Accounts Payable.
in_practice.human_gate: Approve every provider batch and any eligibility interpretation. Scheme changes need separate approval, including assessment of OR rights and CAO or pension-fund constraints.
systems: Excel or a small reconciliation service
data_needed: Employee identifier, employment dates, hours and applicable scheme
Current scheme documents, effective dates and approved elections
Provider file specifications and acknowledgements
Payroll deductions, employer contributions and provider invoices
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted benefits register with source change, rule version, approver, submission identifier and reconciliation result; minimise personal data in technical logs.

evidence.claim: AFAS supports extracting records and controlled record updates; this does not establish compatibility with Noordhaven's providers.
Power Automate supports approval workflows with responses through Outlook or Teams.
The proposed workflow and its estimated savings are plausible but untested at Noordhaven.

risks: Incorrect effective dates or scheme mapping can create gaps in cover or wrong deductions; require provider acknowledgement and reconciliation.
Agency workers must follow their applicable arrangements; do not enrol them as Noordhaven employees by default.
Provider access and file interfaces may prevent automatic submission.

OR rights depend on the arrangement: pension provisions already governed by a CAO or industry pension fund need different treatment. [SER pension guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/faq/instemmingsrecht-arbeidsvoorwaarde-pensioen)
research_questions: Which schemes apply to each employee group, and are any savings arrangements actually offered?
Which providers accept structured change files and return usable acknowledgements?
What share of today's work is matching records versus resolving genuinely ambiguous cases?
Can a shadow run reproduce two months of confirmed cover and contributions without unexplained differences?

tasks.short: Check the grade and pay range for a new or changed role against its actual duties and CAO.

today.trigger: A vacancy, promotion, reorganisation or request to reassess a role.
steps: Collect the role description, actual duties and manager evidence.
Identify the applicable CAO and agreed job evaluation method.
Compare responsibilities with evaluation factors and reference roles.
Check the proposed grade and salary against scales and comparable roles.
Discuss the recommendation and record the approved rationale.
drudgery: Finding previous evaluations and current salary tables
Reformatting the same evidence for each review
today.time_sinks: 125.4 hours/year supplied. Gathering reliable duty evidence and resolving borderline grades probably dominate; confirm through recent cases.

lenses.faster: Turn manager notes into a structured duty summary and retrieve relevant evaluation criteria. Produce an evidence table with unanswered questions.
lenses.autonomous: A complete evaluation request creates a review pack automatically. Missing evidence returns to the requester before a grade recommendation is considered.
lenses.ambitious: Review roles when their duties materially change, rather than waiting for complaints. Check consistency across Rotterdam, Tilburg and Venlo.
lenses.joy: Remove document hunting and repetitive formatting. Spend more time understanding the work and explaining difficult judgments.
lenses.options: Show plausible adjacent grades with supporting and conflicting evidence. Separate the job grade from an individual's salary placement.
lenses.altitude: Maintain the reference-role library and calibration process. Monitor inconsistent interpretations instead of treating every request as a fresh exercise.
reach: HR Business Partner: promotion and organisation-change evidence
Recruiter: approved vacancy pay ranges
People Analytics and HRIS Analyst: grade consistency checks

tasks.human_edge: Observe actual work, challenge inflated descriptions and judge responsibility using the agreed method. US exempt/non-exempt categories should not be imported into Dutch grading.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot: AI organises evidence and drafts comparisons, while the specialist evaluates the role. Approved salary tables and calculations remain deterministic.

in_practice.trigger: A manager submits a new or changed role for evaluation.
steps: Collect a standard questionnaire, current description and examples of actual duties.
Retrieve the applicable evaluation method, reference roles and effective salary tables.
Draft a factor-by-factor evidence comparison and identify missing facts.
Have the specialist interview the manager, determine the recommendation and check internal consistency.
Record approval and pass the authorised grade and range to HR Administration and Recruitment.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist validates every factor assessment; the authorised decision-maker approves the grade and salary placement before AFAS or vacancy records change.
systems: AFAS read-only grade and salary extract
data_needed: Actual duties, responsibilities and reporting relationships
Applicable CAO and authorised evaluation method
Approved reference-role evaluations
Effective salary scales and restricted comparator data
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted role evaluation register with evidence references, method version, human rationale, approval and effective date.

evidence.claim: AFAS GetConnectors can supply configured records for a grade and salary comparison.
AI can plausibly structure duty evidence and draft comparisons, but reliable grading under Noordhaven's method needs validation.

risks: Historical evaluations may encode unequal treatment; use approved factors and examine inconsistent outcomes.
A polished description can conceal actual responsibilities; interviews and observation remain necessary.

Assess the intended use under the EU AI Act if AI recommendations influence employment terms; human approval alone does not settle classification. [European Commission AI Act guidance](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai)

Changing the evaluation system requires a separate assessment of OR rights and existing CAO provisions. [SER consent guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/aan-de-slag-met-de-or/rechten/instemmingsrecht)
research_questions: Which evaluation methods and reference roles govern the two CAO populations?
How often do descriptions differ materially from observed duties?
Does a blinded trial produce useful evidence comparisons without systematically favouring office roles?
Does the proposed AI use merely organise documents, or materially influence employment decisions?

tasks.short: Research benefits and workplace practices, then recommend changes that help our people and fit our budget.

today.trigger: A policy review, employee concern, renewal, regulatory change or adverse workforce trend.
steps: Define the question with HR and the relevant operations or safety owner.
Gather current policies, employee feedback, usage and cost information.
Research authoritative guidance and comparable practices.
Assess benefits, costs, safety implications and implementation requirements.
Recommend a change and agree how its effects will be measured.
drudgery: Repeating searches across websites and supplier material
Comparing policies written in different formats
Building cost tables and presentation drafts
today.time_sinks: 103.3 hours/year supplied. Source checking, comparison and stakeholder input are likely bottlenecks; current research practice is inferred.

lenses.faster: Prepare a dated evidence brief and common comparison table from approved sources. Summarisation and first-draft preparation become much quicker.
lenses.autonomous: A scheduled source check flags changed guidance or scheme terms for review. It creates a research brief without changing company policy.
lenses.ambitious: Test benefits access for night shifts and different sites instead of relying on an annual office survey. Run small, measured pilots before wider adoption.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive searching and slide preparation. Keep employee listening, practical design and discussion of trade-offs.
lenses.options: Compare doing nothing, improving communication, changing eligibility and introducing a targeted benefit. Show cost and access by employee group.
lenses.altitude: Design a continuing policy-review and pilot process. Maintain evidence standards and measure whether changes improve outcomes.
reach: Learning and Development Specialist: aggregate certificate and training-gap analysis
HR Business Partner: structured employee listening
FP&A Analyst: benefits business-case preparation

tasks.human_edge: Judge whether a benefit is useful and accessible during warehouse shifts. Safety professionals and the bedrijfsarts retain their professional responsibilities.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot: AI helps gather, compare and draft evidence, but the specialist defines the question, tests credibility and recommends policy with the responsible stakeholders.

in_practice.trigger: A quarterly review question or a material change detected in a selected authoritative source.
steps: Define the population, problem, budget and desired outcome.
Collect dated source material and privacy-protected internal summaries.
Draft an evidence table distinguishing research findings, supplier claims and assumptions.
Model alternatives and review feasibility with employees, Operations and relevant specialists.
Submit a pilot proposal through the required approval and employee-representation process.
Measure uptake, access, cost and agreed outcomes before recommending expansion.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist verifies sources and recommendations; HR approves policy proposals, with safety, medical and OR involvement where applicable.
data_needed: Current policy versions, eligibility and benefit costs
Aggregate uptake, workforce composition and employee feedback
Aggregate training and certificate gaps where relevant
Authoritative guidance, supplier terms and pilot outcome definitions
in_practice.logs_to: Policy research register with source dates, evidence limitations, assumptions, reviewer decisions and pilot results.

evidence.claim: Power BI parameters support interactive comparison of cost assumptions; the benefits model must still be built.
A source monitoring and evidence drafting workflow is plausible, but its quality and savings have not been demonstrated here.

risks: Supplier claims and observational comparisons can overstate benefits; label evidence quality and test assumptions.
Small site or shift groups can expose individuals; suppress identifiable aggregates and restrict access.

Keep diagnoses and causes of sickness out of employer research datasets. [Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens guidance](https://autoriteitpersoonsgegevens.nl/themas/werk-en-uitkering/zieke-werknemers/regels-voor-werkgevers-bij-zieke-werknemers)

Changes to working conditions or absence policy can involve OR consent; establish the applicable process before implementation. [SER consent guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/aan-de-slag-met-de-or/rechten/instemmingsrecht)
research_questions: Which employee groups have low benefits access, and what evidence explains the gap?
Can existing data answer the question without individual health information?
Do proposed sources provide independent evidence relevant to Dutch logistics?
What pilot result would justify adoption or cause Noordhaven to stop?

tasks.short: Explain Dutch pay, benefits and CAO rules to managers and employees using the right policy for their situation.

today.trigger: An employee or manager asks about pay, benefits, classification or an employment procedure.
steps: Clarify the question and obtain only the necessary employment facts.
Find the applicable Dutch rule, CAO clause and company policy version.
Check interpretation and consult Payroll, the HR Business Partner or legal adviser when needed.
Explain the answer and any choices or next steps.
Record the advice and pass authorised actions to the responsible colleague.
drudgery: Searching long CAO and policy documents
Answering repeated questions from different sites
Rewriting technical language into understandable English or Dutch
today.time_sinks: 99.1 hours/year supplied. Repeated lookups and clarification may consume substantial time, but case mix and response delays are unknown.

lenses.faster: Retrieve the relevant passages and prepare a plain-language answer with clause references. Repeated document searches and first drafts largely disappear.
lenses.autonomous: A new question creates a case, identifies missing facts and prepares a sourced draft. Conflicting or missing sources stop the draft and prompt escalation.
lenses.ambitious: Give shift workers access to approved explanations outside office hours. Use recurring questions to improve onboarding and benefits communication.
lenses.joy: Remove repeated clause hunting and standard wording. Keep the conversations where context, reassurance and judgment matter.
lenses.options: Prepare a short employee explanation, a manager checklist and a detailed specialist note from the same verified sources. Show alternatives only where the rules allow a choice.
lenses.altitude: Maintain a reliable advice library with named owners and expiry dates. Improve policy clarity using recurring questions and corrections.
reach: HR Administrator: routine policy enquiries
Recruiter: consistent explanations of offer benefits
HR Business Partner: initial preparation of complex advice cases

tasks.human_edge: Recognise anxiety, conflict and facts that change the interpretation. The specialist remains responsible for personalised advice and escalation.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot: retrieval and drafting support the adviser. Personalised legal, pay and benefits interpretations are reviewed before anyone relies on them.

in_practice.trigger: An enquiry enters a restricted HR mailbox or intake form.
steps: Identify the topic, employee group, relevant date and missing facts.
Retrieve only authorised, effective CAO and policy passages.
Draft an answer with source references, assumptions and an escalation flag.
Have the specialist verify interpretation and deliver the personalised response.
Record the outcome and propose reusable FAQ wording for separate approval.
in_practice.human_gate: Review every personalised answer. Only previously approved general FAQ text is available directly; conflicting rules and legal disputes go to the designated expert.
systems: Permission-aware retrieval and approved LLM environment, proposed
data_needed: Question and minimum necessary employment context
Applicable CAO, contract terms and relevant dates
Current approved policies and interpretation notes
Named policy owners and escalation contacts
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted enquiry register with sources used, reviewer, final answer and action owner; avoid duplicating sensitive attachments.

evidence.claim: Retrieval and drafting can plausibly reduce repeated policy searches, but accuracy across Noordhaven's CAOs needs testing.
Power Automate can route drafted material for human approval; it does not validate legal interpretation.

risks: Using the wrong CAO, effective date or contract exception can produce convincing but incorrect advice.
Retrieval must preserve document permissions and prevent one employee seeing another employee's records.

Wet verbetering poortwachter questions require coordination with the absence owner and bedrijfsarts; this workflow must not make medical or return-to-work judgments. [UWV guidance](https://www.uwv.nl/nl/ziek/werkwijzer-poortwachter)
The O*NET reference to state and federal law needs translation into Dutch employment rules, rather than literal reuse.
research_questions: What proportion of enquiries can be answered from approved documents without specialist interpretation?
Are both CAOs and all policy exceptions available with reliable effective dates?
Can a test set detect wrong-CAO answers, missing facts and unsupported statements?
Which communication formats actually reach warehouse and transport employees on shifts?

tasks.short: Design and run salary reviews and incentive arrangements within our CAOs, budget and approval rules.

today.trigger: A salary review, CAO increase, incentive cycle or request for a new compensation arrangement.
steps: Agree the objective, eligible population, budget and applicable constraints.
Collect salaries, hours, grades and approved manager inputs.
Calculate proposed changes and check affordability and consistency.
Resolve exceptions and obtain management and required employee-representation approvals.
Pass approved changes to Payroll and check implementation.
drudgery: Checking eligibility, rounding and duplicate changes
today.time_sinks: 98.2 hours/year supplied. Spreadsheet consolidation and revisions are likely savings opportunities; approval and consultation time remain.

lenses.faster: Use one controlled population and calculation model for all revisions. Eligibility checks, budget totals and letter drafts update together.
lenses.autonomous: Opening a cycle creates manager worklists and calculates outcomes under approved rules. Missing decisions and policy exceptions route to the specialist.
lenses.ambitious: Check salary compression and inconsistent progression before the annual review. Test whether compensation changes support offer acceptance and 90-day retention.
lenses.joy: Remove workbook merging and repetitive arithmetic. Keep programme design, manager challenge and fair treatment.
lenses.options: Compare fixed increases, percentage increases and targeted compression corrections within the same budget. Separate mandatory CAO changes from discretionary proposals.
lenses.altitude: Own the compensation rules, approval structure and outcome checks. Run a controlled cycle rather than manually assemble every allocation.
reach: FP&A Analyst: workforce pay-budget scenarios
Payroll Specialist: validated change-file preparation
HR Business Partner: manager calibration support

tasks.human_edge: Choose defensible objectives, challenge unfair allocations and explain trade-offs. Managers and authorised leaders own discretionary decisions.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: deterministic software calculates approved rules and prepares changes, while people approve programme design, individual discretionary awards and payroll release. AI drafts explanations rather than inventing awards.

in_practice.trigger: An authorised compensation cycle opens or an approved CAO change reaches its effective date.
steps: Freeze and reconcile the AFAS population, salaries and applicable rules.
Calculate mandatory changes separately from discretionary scenarios.
Collect manager proposals and flag budget, eligibility and consistency exceptions.
Obtain programme and individual approvals through the agreed process.
Prepare a controlled payroll import and employee communication drafts.
Have Payroll validate results and reconcile approved amounts with the completed payroll.
in_practice.human_gate: HR and Finance approve programme rules and budget; managers approve discretionary proposals; Payroll authorises execution. Establish any required OR process before changing the system.
systems: Excel or a tested calculation service
data_needed: Effective salaries, FTE, grades and employment dates
Approved CAO tables, eligibility rules and compensation policy
Budget and authorised manager proposals
Payroll import specification and reconciliation totals
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted compensation cycle register with frozen input version, rule version, proposals, approvals, import identifier and payroll reconciliation.

evidence.claim: Power BI supports interactive parameter-based scenarios, providing a component for pay-budget comparisons.
Power Automate supports sequential and multiple-approver workflows.
The integrated compensation cycle and estimated savings require company-specific implementation and validation.

risks: Combining mandatory and discretionary increases incorrectly can breach the applicable CAO or misstate the budget.
Incentives based on unsafe throughput or sickness attendance can encourage harmful behaviour; programme design needs operational and employee scrutiny.
OR consent concerns remuneration systems rather than every individual bonus amount. [SER remuneration guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/faq/beloningssysteem)

Adding AI-generated individual award recommendations changes the intended use and needs a fresh EU AI Act assessment. [European Commission guidance](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai)
research_questions: Which populations permit discretionary pay, and which outcomes are prescribed by a CAO?
Can the calculation model reproduce the last completed cycle, including retroactive changes?
How much cycle time is active calculation work versus waiting for decisions?
Which proposed incentives might distort safety, attendance reporting or cooperation?

tasks.short: Investigate pay and grading complaints and advise on a fair, well-supported resolution.

today.trigger: An employee or manager disputes salary, grade, allowance or the treatment of a comparable role.
steps: Hear the complaint and clarify the disputed facts and requested outcome.
Collect relevant contract, payroll, role and policy evidence.
Check calculations and compare treatment using authorised comparator information.
Discuss findings and resolution options with the responsible HR colleague or adviser.
Explain the recommendation and record approved action and any review route.
today.time_sinks: 98.1 hours/year supplied. Evidence preparation is reducible; listening, disputed facts and resolution discussions remain substantial.

lenses.faster: Build the chronology, cited evidence pack and calculation checks automatically. The specialist starts with the disputed points instead of reconstructing the file.
lenses.autonomous: A complaint creates a restricted case and evidence checklist. Calculations and missing-document reminders run automatically, while resolution advice waits for review.
lenses.ambitious: Find repeated payroll or grading problems across cases and correct the underlying rule. Check whether an identified error affects other employees.
lenses.joy: Remove file hunting and timeline assembly. Preserve listening, careful explanation and repairing trust.
lenses.options: Prepare supported routes such as correcting an error, requesting reevaluation or maintaining the decision with reasons. Show uncertainty and authority needed for each.
lenses.altitude: Improve the complaint process, evidence standards and prevention controls. Use recurring issues to improve payroll and grading quality.
reach: HR Business Partner: factual preparation for employee cases
Payroll Specialist: disputed pay recalculation
HR Administrator: case completeness and follow-up tracking

tasks.human_edge: Hear both sides, recognise unfairness and own the advice. The earlier automate score overstates what should be delegated: evidence preparation is automatable, resolution is not.
tasks.pattern_why: copilot with keep_human resolution: software assembles evidence and checks arithmetic; the specialist assesses disputed facts, advises on a remedy and handles the conversation. No automatic denial or settlement.

in_practice.trigger: A salary or grading complaint is registered through the existing HR route.
steps: Record the employee's account, disputed period and requested remedy.
Retrieve authorised historical records and build a source-linked chronology.
Recalculate the disputed pay using effective rules and identify evidence gaps.
Have the specialist hear relevant parties and assess resolution options.
Obtain authorised approval, explain the outcome and track any correction or appeal.
in_practice.human_gate: A person validates evidence, recommends the resolution and communicates it. Any settlement, grading change or payroll correction follows the existing authority rules.
systems: Approved LLM environment for case drafting, proposed
data_needed: Complaint and employee-provided evidence
Historical contracts, pay records and role changes
Effective CAO provisions, salary scales and approvals
Minimum necessary comparator evidence and applicable complaint procedure
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted complaint record with evidence provenance, calculation version, human findings, authorised remedy and review status.

evidence.claim: Document structuring and deterministic recalculation can plausibly reduce case preparation effort.
Neither the supplied score nor the proposed workflow demonstrates reliable autonomous complaint resolution.

risks: AI summaries may omit evidence favourable to the employee; review both supporting and conflicting material.
Comparator salaries and grievance records require strict access controls and limited disclosure.
Past settlements may be exceptional and should not automatically become precedent.

Using AI to recommend consequential employment outcomes needs assessment under the EU AI Act; retaining a reviewer does not by itself remove that issue. [European Commission guidance](https://digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/regulatory-framework-ai)
research_questions: What proportion of complaints concern arithmetic errors versus contested judgment or unequal treatment?
Can a trial evidence pack preserve every material fact without inventing conclusions?
Who has authority to approve each type of remedy, and what review routes apply?
Do employees and HR Business Partners find the supported process clearer and fairer?

tasks.short: Maintain clear job descriptions, approved classifications and current salary scales for all three sites.

today.trigger: A new role, approved evaluation, CAO salary-table change or scheduled catalogue review.
steps: Collect approved role facts, classification decisions and effective salary tables.
Draft or revise the description using the company template.
Check titles, grade references and scale calculations across documents.
Obtain manager and specialist approval.
Publish the controlled version and arrange updates in AFAS and recruitment materials.
drudgery: Updating the same grade or scale in multiple documents
today.time_sinks: 92.5 hours/year supplied. Drafting and synchronising approved information are the main proposed savings; evaluating a contested grade belongs to the separate evaluation task.

lenses.faster: Generate descriptions from structured role facts and calculate scales from approved inputs. Version comparisons highlight only meaningful changes.
lenses.autonomous: An approved evaluation or salary-table change prepares affected documents and update lists. Publication waits for approval.
lenses.ambitious: Maintain a consistent role catalogue across all three sites. Connect progression requirements to relevant Studytube learning without treating course completion as proof of competence.
lenses.joy: Remove repetitive wording and document synchronisation. Keep conversations about realistic duties and understandable career paths.
lenses.options: Create employee, manager and vacancy versions from one approved role record. Compare wording alternatives while keeping grade and responsibilities consistent.
lenses.altitude: Own the role catalogue, templates and change rules. Check drift between actual work, approved descriptions and vacancy wording.
reach: Recruiter: approved vacancy responsibilities and pay ranges
Learning and Development Specialist: role-to-learning mapping
HR Administrator: controlled role-record updates

tasks.human_edge: Confirm that descriptions reflect real work and that classifications have been properly approved. Managers validate operational duties; the specialist protects consistency.
tasks.pattern_why: agent_with_gate: an llm_step drafts descriptions from approved facts, while deterministic software handles scales and consistency checks. People approve publication and downstream changes.

in_practice.trigger: An approved role evaluation, role change or effective salary-table update.
steps: Read the approved role facts, evaluation outcome and applicable salary table.
Generate draft descriptions and calculate scales using explicit rounding and effective-date rules.
Check changed fields against AFAS records and affected recruitment materials.
Route descriptions to managers and classifications and scales to the specialist for approval.
Publish the approved catalogue version and prepare authorised system updates.
in_practice.human_gate: Managers approve duties; the specialist approves classification references and scale calculations. A changed evaluation method requires its own approval process.
systems: Approved LLM environment and approval workflow, proposed
data_needed: Approved duties, reporting relationships and role identifiers
Authorised evaluation outcomes and reference classifications
Current CAO salary tables, effective dates and rounding rules
Document templates and downstream role references
in_practice.logs_to: Role catalogue change log with source approval, document version, scale calculation version, publication date and downstream update status.

evidence.claim: Power Automate can route document approvals before subsequent workflow actions.
Generating several document versions from structured role facts is plausible; automatic synchronisation with every company system is unproven.

risks: Generated descriptions can invent responsibilities, qualifications or managerial authority; require traceability to approved role facts.
A wrong scale effective date or rounding rule can propagate widely; compare against the authorised source before release.

Changes to the job evaluation system can involve OR consent; routine publication and system redesign need distinct treatment. [SER consent guidance](https://www.ser.nl/nl/thema/medezeggenschap/aan-de-slag-met-de-or/rechten/instemmingsrecht)
Do not count the same evaluation research or approval savings again under this document-maintenance task.
research_questions: Is there one authoritative role identifier across AFAS, SharePoint and Recruitee?
How much work is document production versus substantive role evaluation?
Can approved structured facts generate acceptable descriptions without invented duties?
Can a sample salary-table update be traced accurately through every affected document and system?

tasks.short: Calculate the full cost and workforce effects of pay proposals before CAO or company negotiations.

today.trigger: CAO negotiations, an employer pay proposal or a request for workforce cost scenarios.
steps: Agree the proposal, population, baseline period and costing assumptions.
Collect payroll, hours, allowances, employer costs and relevant agency information.
Build and reconcile the baseline cost model.
Calculate scenarios and explain differences by site, employee group and period.
Review with Finance and prepare the approved negotiation briefing.
today.time_sinks: 60.9 hours/year supplied. Data preparation and repeated scenario runs are reducible; negotiation calendars and decisions are not.

lenses.faster: Reuse a reconciled cost model with adjustable proposal inputs. Revised tables and explanations are generated without rebuilding the workbook.
lenses.autonomous: A fresh approved payroll snapshot refreshes the baseline and reruns saved scenarios. Unexplained reconciliation differences stop publication.
lenses.ambitious: Model phased increases, allowance interactions and seasonal agency demand before negotiations start. Show which assumptions drive the result.
lenses.joy: Remove formula copying and chart rebuilding. Keep testing proposals and helping negotiators understand trade-offs.
lenses.options: Compare percentage increases, fixed amounts, staged implementation and allowance changes. Show first-year and annualised cost with headcount and agency-volume sensitivities.
lenses.altitude: Own the labour-cost model, assumptions and validation rules. Help leaders choose which questions to test rather than calculate each request manually.
reach: FP&A Analyst: labour-cost sensitivities
Controller: payroll-to-ledger reconciliation support
HR Director: negotiation evidence and proposal comparisons

tasks.human_edge: Choose realistic assumptions, distinguish cost facts from negotiating positions and explain uncertainty. Leadership owns negotiating mandates and commitments.
tasks.pattern_why: deterministic_software: explicit formulas calculate costs from a reconciled snapshot. AI can help build the model and draft commentary, but calculations run without a model and publication remains gated.

in_practice.trigger: An approved proposal changes or a new reconciled payroll baseline becomes available.
steps: Freeze a dated payroll snapshot and reconcile population and costs to payroll and ledger totals.
Map components to approved CAO, employer-cost and agency-pricing assumptions.
Run saved scenarios through tested formulas, separating first-year and annualised effects.
Produce group-level tables, sensitivities and explanations linked to calculated values.
Have the specialist and Finance validate material assumptions before releasing the briefing.
in_practice.human_gate: The specialist approves CAO interpretation and Finance signs off the baseline and costing assumptions. The HR Director approves negotiation material and mandates.
systems: AFAS payroll and general ledger extracts
data_needed: Payroll components, paid hours, FTE and applicable CAO by employee group
Employer contribution rules, allowances and relevant cost dependencies
Agency hours, rates and contractual price-change terms
Proposal effective dates, headcount assumptions and reconciled ledger totals
in_practice.logs_to: Restricted scenario register with snapshot date, input totals, formula version, assumptions, reconciliation results and release approvals.

evidence.claim: Power BI parameters allow users to change assumptions and observe calculated scenario effects.
A reusable deterministic model can plausibly reduce repeated costing work; the full model and estimated savings are unvalidated.

risks: The nightly Power BI extract can lag payroll corrections; show snapshot dates and reconcile the baseline before release.
Missing allowance interactions, employer charges or retroactive effects can materially understate a proposal's cost.
Agency prices depend on their contracts; do not assume employee pay increases translate directly into identical agency-rate changes.
Group averages can conceal uneven effects, while very small groups can reveal individual pay; choose aggregation and access controls deliberately.
research_questions: Can the baseline reconcile to payroll and the general ledger with explained differences?
Which employer costs and allowances change when base pay changes?
Do agency contracts provide enough information to model rate changes credibly?
Can the model reproduce a previous negotiated change, including timing and retroactive effects?

role.altitude: Become the owner of Noordhaven's reward rules, evidence and controls: reliable benefits administration, consistent job evaluation and explainable labour-cost decisions.
reach: Recruitment: maintain approved offer ranges and benefits explanations, then examine associations with offer acceptance and 90-day retention.
HR Administration: own benefits and role-data quality controls while administrators retain routine employee-record ownership.
Payroll: supply validated compensation changes and reconciliation evidence while Payroll retains calculation and release accountability.
FP&A and Controller: maintain shared labour-cost scenarios and explain payroll-to-budget differences.
Learning and Development: connect approved role requirements to learning pathways and certificate requirements.
role.ceiling_note: These eight tasks total 870.6 hours/year, about 54.4% of the implied 1,600-hour role. The estimates suggest roughly 389 hours/year of released capacity, about 24.3% of the whole role, worth approximately EUR 29,200 at EUR 75/hour before implementation, licensing and maintenance costs; this is capacity value, not cash savings. Current steps and work anatomy are inferred, and all savings and speedups are pilot hypotheses. Savings refer to specialist working time; speedups include automation and remaining review, while external waiting limits elapsed-time gains. Do not extrapolate to unlisted work or double-count shared preparation. Interviews, complaints, negotiations and accountable decisions continue to need people.
skills_to_grow: Translate CAO and scheme provisions into effective-dated, testable rules.
Validate payroll and benefits calculations, reconciliations and historical corrections.
Design controlled AFAS extracts and workflow requirements with the HRIS Analyst.
Evaluate AI drafts against sources, permissions and realistic failure cases.
